expected_differences: The account initial, truncated account name and unread badges replace Maya’s fixture portrait and identity. Production does not need an added Demo label.
The fixture’s revision-resume row is absent; it should appear only when this account has an actual resumable revision.

Production titles, businesses, spot counts, deadlines and the additional Recreate opportunity correctly differ from the Lab records. Existing demo wording within supplied records is not migration drift.
The actual payments are $75.00 per approved version, $25.00 after 24h live and approval, and $300.00 per month—not the fixture amounts.
The supplied reference photograph, Story artwork and campaign vehicle visual replace the Lab assets. The reference remains explicitly labeled as a still, without invented playback controls.
The vehicle campaign exposes its actual rear-window placement, 30-day duration and named vehicle eligibility rather than the Lab’s generic vehicle requirement.
keep: Mineral canvas, graphite commitment planes, cobalt Recreate payments and white Car caption; ordinary records remain unboxed and shadow-free.
The 320px adaptation: wrapped Kind filter, source-above-commitment Recreate layout, 16px gutters and 12px-inset commitment edge. Longer task titles wrap without clipping.
Opaque reference labels and Inspect reference controls, contained source imagery, and the intact square-cornered Story sheet with restrained source shadow.
Distinct financial treatments: white money on cobalt for Recreate, ink beside the short Story payment edge, and an attached inset monthly Car caption.
Visible conditional-payment language, deadlines, eligibility and separate View work and Save actions.
The labeled Home, Activity, Earnings and Profile navigation with its selected edge. Its document-end position is a capture accommodation, not navigation drift.
review.readiness_note: Visual sign-off at 320px. The capture shows the real records, states and action entry points without obstruction; it cannot verify Save persistence and failure handling, filter responses, inspection behavior or application-detail transitions.
review.why: Pass 2 preserves the approved hierarchy while making the required narrow-screen adaptations rather than squeezing the 390px split into 320px. Recreate retains its identifiable source, graphite task information and stepped cobalt payment region. Story remains a separate supplied sheet with conditions outside the artwork and a short payment-only accent. Car retains its broad image and immediately attached, 12px-inset white caption, with amount and title stacked legibly. Typography, surface treatment and action placement closely match the Lab. Amounts, payment bases, long titles and deadlines remain readable; no controls collide or disappear. The campaign image is identified as a campaign visual with supplied artwork, not presented as verified installation evidence. No material implementation drift is visible.
review.verdict: Yes—Frame Shift was faithfully transferred at 320px, with real data and visible functionality preserved; runtime behavior remains outside what this capture can prove.
